name: Home Assistant Control
description: Gives MoaBot a bounded set of Home Assistant service-call actions (starting with Music Assistant playback) so voice requests can act, not just observe. Deliberately scoped, not a generic call-any-service passthrough.

baseUrl.description: Home Assistant base URL, e.g. http://10.0.0.108:8123 (REST API, not the WebSocket URL).

defaultMediaPlayerEntityId.description: The Music-Assistant-owned media_player entity to target by default — NOT the native ESPHome/Voice-PE entity (e.g. media_player.home_assistant_voice_0aacc1, not ..._media_player); music_assistant.play_media's target schema only accepts entities from the music_assistant integration itself.

musicAssistantConfigEntryId.description: HA config_entries entry_id for the Music Assistant integration instance, required by music_assistant.search (GET /api/config/config_entries/entry, filter domain=music_assistant).
